biography_sections.title: Original evidence and remaining gaps
biography_sections.markdown:
### NRS Kilwaghter estate targets — 21 September 2026

The National Records of Scotland catalogue identifies precise **Open, On site** sources for the earlier Kilwaughter household: [GD154/514](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f514&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) and [GD154/515](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f515&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (c.1653), [GD154/525](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f525&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (c.1690; two items), [GD154/530](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f530&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (November 1692; three items), and [GD154/532](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f532&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (1693–1708; eight items).

No online catalogue description names Glasgow or gives an image/transcription. Search the originals under `Kilwaghter`, `Kilwaughter`, `Kilwaugheter` and Glasgow spelling variants. A named tenant could test the 1669 John’s continuity, but cannot by itself prove John senior’s identity or kinship.

biography_sections.title: The 1733 Kilroot index is not a will
biography_sections.markdown:
PRONI’s detail identifies **John Glasgow, Kilroot, 1733** as a Connor diocesan administration-bond index entry. Its descriptive fields are blank, the original is lost, and no administrator, relative or exact death date survives. It is a younger-namesake candidate, not proof of a father or descendant. The 1740 Ballyboggy lessee cannot be the same deceased-estate John without resolving the chronology.

Source: [PRONI Name Search](https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx).
